The girl then said it was $5 and looked at me expectantly, probably wanting me to pay for it. I was really upset because she was rude and just looked at me, expecting me to pay without even asking. So, I just shrugged and walked away. Later, my partner called me an asshole when I told her the story. Now, I'm wondering if I did the right thing or not. But she also had a spilled drink, which was probably an accident caused by my son. So, she might have been upset about her drink being spilled, but her approach was definitely not the best. She didn't even ask nicely; she just looked at me expectantly, probably assuming I would pay for it. On my side, I was already upset because she was rude. My son is 3, so he's still learning, and accidents happen. I asked him if he did it, and he admitted to bumping it. So, I knew he was responsible in a way, but he's a kid. I was probably feeling defensive because she was being rude, and I didn't want to reward that behavior by paying for her drink just because she was upset. Then, I just shrugged and walked away. That might have seemed like I was ignoring the situation, but I was actually trying to handle it in a way that didn't escalate things. I didn't want to get into an argument with her, especially in a public place with my son around. But my partner called me an asshole when I told her about it. That's confusing. Did I do something wrong? Maybe she thought I should have handled it differently, like apologized or offered to pay for the drink despite her rudeness.
